0022600088.text: The Chicago Bulls open their 2026-27 season as the visitors against the Toronto Raptors, who have also not yet played a game this season. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Isaac Okoro, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle, who is day-to-day with a foot injury. Toronto won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bulls a 25% chance of winning.
